content.tagline: Clean beauty, honest to the skin
content.descriptor: Korean vegan care for sensitive skin: the Panthenolca Repair line on panthenol, TECA and PDRN, and the Signal Light line — cleansing, sun care and sheet masks
about: SEUNGGUN COSMETICS CO., LTD. is a Korean company that makes skincare under its own brand, LOOBEE, and at the same time works as a manufacturer: formulation development, production, export and OEM, ODM and private label services. A buyer can take a finished brand, or arrive with their own.

The company states LOOBEE's position as clean vegan cosmetics: formulations free of animal-derived ingredients and free of animal testing. The brand's materials are gathered around one idea — care should be calm on the skin and honest in its composition.

The range is split into two lines with different jobs. Panthenolca Repair works on the barrier and on dryness: panthenol, TECA, PDRN and ceramide NP. Signal Light covers the daily cycle — cleansing, sun protection and sheet masks, each mask for its own concern.

Today, according to the company, exports go mainly to China and the United States and sales run largely online: Taobao and Pinduoduo in China, TikTok Shop in the US. The company is open to other markets and names Latin America and North America in particular, where it is looking for importers, distributors and retail chains.
facts: Own brand LOOBEE plus development, manufacturing and export
OEM, ODM and private label under the buyer's own brand
Vegan formulations: no animal-derived ingredients and no animal testing
Dermatological testing and a Dermatest® EXCELLENT rating — as declared by the company
Exports to China and the United States; online sales through Taobao, Pinduoduo and TikTok Shop
Latin America and North America named as priority markets for expansion
channels: Brand owners — OEM, ODM, private label

lines.name: Panthenolca Repair
lines.note: The line for sensitive skin and a compromised barrier. The formula rests on panthenol, TECA, PDRN and ceramide NP. Five products cover the whole cycle: a pack cleanser left on the skin for one to three minutes and rinsed off; a bubble serum as a booster after washing; a cream mist that also works over makeup; a rich PDRN cream with niacinamide for radiance and wrinkle care; and a sheet mask on a bamboo sheet. According to the company the products passed dermatological testing and testing on sensitive skin.

lines.name: Signal Light
lines.note: The daily line, six products. Cleansing in two steps: a vegan cleansing oil with 50% sunflower seed oil and a mildly acidic foam built on ectoin, panthenol and Centella. An essence-type SPF 50+ PA++++ sunscreen on mineral filters, with a tone-up effect and no white cast. And three sheet masks split by concern: RED for hydration and soothing, YELLOW for dullness and radiance, GREEN for firmness on hydrolysed collagen; the last, according to the company, is being prepared for launch.

tech.name: Panthenol and TECA
tech.note: The pairing the Panthenolca Repair line rests on. The company uses panthenol as a barrier-strengthening and soothing component, and TECA as a Centella derivative. Both lines are built on gentle formulations for skin that reacts to strong actives.

tech.name: PDRN
tech.note: Present in the pack cleanser, the bubble serum and the cream of the Panthenolca Repair line. The company presents it as part of gentle daily care rather than as a clinical treatment.

tech.name: Vegan formulation
tech.note: The company states that no animal-derived ingredients are used and no animal testing is carried out across the range, including the collagen mask, where the collagen is listed as vegan. The Vegan mark appears on its own materials.

tech.name: Testing
tech.note: The brand's materials carry marks for dermatological testing, a Dermatest® EXCELLENT rating and testing on sensitive skin. These are the company's statements; copies of the reports are requested at the deal stage.

tech.name: Manufacturing under another brand
tech.note: Alongside its own brand the company offers OEM, ODM and private label services. For a buyer that means two routes: take LOOBEE as a finished brand, or develop a line under their own.

content.exportNote: According to the company, exports today go mainly to China and the United States, and sales run largely online: Taobao and Pinduoduo in China, TikTok Shop in the US. The company is open to cooperation on other markets and names Latin America and North America in particular, where it is looking for importers, distributors, retail chains and other professional channels. Through Teranova it is ready to discuss long-term partnerships on those markets.

content.seoDesc: LOOBEE by SEUNGGUN COSMETICS is Korean vegan skincare for sensitive skin: the Panthenolca Repair line on panthenol, TECA and PDRN, and the Signal Light line with cleansing, SPF 50+ sun care and sheet masks. OEM, ODM and private label. Supply through Teranova.
catalog_notes: Panthenolca Repair PDRN Pack Cleanser — a wash-off pack cleanser: applied to dry skin before washing, left on for one to three minutes, then rinsed. Panthenol, TECA and ceramide NP, with mild exfoliation, suitable for daily use.
Panthenolca Repair Bubble Serum — a booster serum after cleansing. High-concentration panthenol in a bubble texture, buildable in layers to a dewy finish.
Panthenolca Repair Cream Mist — a cream and mist hybrid. Sprayed straight after cleansing, and usable over makeup. Panthenol, TECA and Centella asiatica extract.
Panthenolca Repair PDRN Cream — a rich dual-function cream for radiance and wrinkle care. Niacinamide, dermatologically tested, vegan formulation.
Panthenolca Repair Mask — a sheet mask on a bamboo sheet with close adhesion. Panthenol, TECA and ceramide. Low-irritation tested for sensitive skin.
Signal Light Cleansing Oil — a vegan cleansing oil with 50% sunflower seed oil. Dissolves makeup and stays gentle around the eye area. Green tea seed and jojoba oils.
Signal Light Cleansing Foam — a mildly acidic foam on seven key ingredients: ectoin, panthenol and Centella asiatica extract. Vegan surfactants, no tight feeling after washing.
Signal Light Tone-up Sun Cream — an essence-type SPF 50+ PA++++ sunscreen on mineral filters. Niacinamide, adenosine and tocopherol. Tone-up without a white cast.
Signal Light RED Mask — a hydrating mask for moments of redness and dryness. Glycerin, trehalose, hyaluronic acid, allantoin and beta-glucan.
Signal Light YELLOW Mask — a mask for dull skin. Panthenol, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, tocopherol and sea buckthorn fruit extract.
Signal Light GREEN Collagen Mask — a collagen mask on hydrolysed collagen with trehalose and hyaluronic acid. According to the company it is being prepared for launch.
